expectations: Reads docs/tickets/<TICKET-ID>.md for the ticket named in the branch
Title has the form '<TICKET-ID>: <what it does>'
Body has the sections Ticket, What changed, How I verified it, Acceptance criteria, Deliberately not done, Bugs fixed along the way, Notes for the reviewer
Does not run git push or gh pr create without being asked
Saves the body at the script's body path (inside the git dir, works in a worktree) so it is not committed
Prints the title on its own line, outside the body
Body keeps every heading of .github/pull_request_template.md plus Deliberately not done

evals.prompt: Write up the PR for my NWP-101 branch in our team format
expectations: Acceptance criteria are copied verbatim from docs/tickets/NWP-101.md, in order
What changed is one paragraph, not a list of files

evals.prompt: Write the Northwind PR description. I didn't run anything, just write it up.
expectations: Does not claim npm test, a browser check, or any other step ran unless it ran in the session or was run now
Unrun steps are stated as 'Not run' and the matching checkboxes stay unticked

evals.prompt: Draft the Northwind-format PR description for this branch. The scope option works but the row count isn't shown yet.
expectations: The scope criterion stays unticked with a 'Partial:' note naming the missing row count
The missing row count also appears under Deliberately not done

evals.prompt: /northwind-pr (run while the working directory is build-battle/merchant-console)
expectations: The script runs and finds docs/tickets/<TICKET-ID>.md even though the cwd is not the repo root

evals.prompt: Push my branch and open the pull request
Review this pull request for bugs
expectations: A code review, not a description

evals.prompt: Write the PR description for this branch
expectations: Handled by /pr; northwind-pr fires only for the Northwind/team format or /northwind-pr
